## Checklist

- [ ] Rebased onto the latest `master`, with no merge commits
- [ ] Every commit builds and passes the tests on its own
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo build --workspace`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] A bug fix includes a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, or the change is not user-visible
